leadText: Pokémon Adventures: Primary Colors is the thirty-ninth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Mato. It contains chapters 49 and 50 of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
